method_note: V4 + decision hysteresis: OPPORTUNITY and ENTRY remain separate; a confirmed BUY_READY is held for at least 15 minutes and requires two consecutive degraded scans to downgrade, unless a hard structural invalidation (HEI/too-late/illiquidity/wide-spread/chase emergency) occurs.

goal_context.note: Goal affects sizing guardrails only; it never inflates signal scores.
